title: Te Karanga Kāore i Whakarongohia i te Whenua o te Whakakake
intro: Kei roto koe i ngā ururua o tētahi ao nui i mua, i te wāhi kāore he rohe o te mana me te whakapehapeha. I haereere tētahi karere i waenganui i a rātou, e karanga ana ki te pono, engari i whakapakeketia ō rātou ngākau. Kāore i arohia te whakatūpato, ā, ko te rangi tonu i huri hei taputapu mō te riri. Ko wai tēnei karere, ā, i pēhea te hunga i whakakahore i te karanga?
clues: I tonoa ahau ki tētahi iwi kaha rawa atu, ā, i hanga e rātou he tohu whakamaumahara ki runga i ngā wāhi tiketike katoa.
I whakaaro tōku iwi kāore e taea te hinga, ā, i mea rātou, 'Ko wai te mea kaha ake i a tātou?'
I karanga ahau i a rātou kia karakia ki a Allah anake, engari i whakapae rātou i ahau mō te wairangi me te teka.
I werohia ahau e rātou kia whiua ahau mēnā i pono ahau, kia rite ki taku i oati ai.
I tukua e Allah he hau pākoki ki a rātou, kāore i mahue tetahi mea i pā mai ki a rātou.
I whakaorangia ahau, me te hunga i whakapono tahi me ahau, i te aroha o Allah, ko te hunga whakateka ia i whakangaromia rawatia.

arabic: فَأَنجَيْنَـٰهُ وَٱلَّذِينَ مَعَهُۥ بِرَحْمَةٍۢ مِّنَّا وَقَطَعْنَا دَابِرَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا ۖ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ مُؤْمِنِينَ
verse: So We saved him and those with him by mercy from Us. And We eliminated those who denied Our signs, and they were not [at all] believers. (7:72)
